translationRepairs: On xinyou day officials were forbidden at banquets and entertainments to present memorials on private affairs.
On xinyou day, officials were forbidden to present petitions concerning private matters during banquets and entertainments.
禁群臣遇宴樂奏請私事 forbids officials from submitting private petitions during banquets and entertainments. This wording states both the prohibited act and its occasion directly.
On xinyou day, forbidden officials at banquets and entertainments to present memorials on private affairs.
On xinyou day, officials were forbidden, when at banquets and entertainments, to submit requests concerning private matters.
The original literal English is ungrammatical. The revision preserves 遇宴樂 as the occasion and 奏請私事 as the prohibited act.
On gengwu day Tieli Xianmen came to court; because this was his first tribute, he was promoted to Right Defender of the Gate Commandant grand general.
On gengwu day Tieli Xianmen came to court; because this was his first tribute, he was promoted to Grand General of the Right Gate Guard.

右監門衛大將軍 is the Tang-style office Grand General of the Right Gate Guard; “Right Defender of the Gate Commandant grand general” garbles the title, and the proposed rendering matches the Chinese office name.
On guimao day of the third month associate regent of Nanjing Xiao Taliege was made Left yilibi and Tanggu, who administered Right yilibi affairs, was made Right yilibi.
On guimao day of the third month Xiao Taliege, associate regent of Nanjing, was made Left yilibi and Tanggu, who administered Right yilibi affairs, was made Right yilibi.
以同知南京留守事蕭塔烈葛 marks 同知南京留守事 as Xiao Taliege’s prior office, not part of the personal name; moving the office into apposition removes the false name fusion.

On wuzi day Palace Front commander Yelü Yixian was made campaign army supreme commander, Zhongshun Army military commissioner Xia Xingmei deputy commander, and Northeastern detail-stable Yelü Muzhe army supervisor to attack Puniuli chieftain Taodeli.

On wuzi day, Yelü Yixian, commander of the Palace Front, was appointed supreme campaign commander; Xia Xingmei, military commissioner of the Zhongshun Army, was appointed his deputy; and Yelü Shuzhe, Northeastern xiangwen, was appointed army supervisor for the campaign against Taodeli, chieftain of Puniuli.

東北面詳穩 is the Khitan office Northeastern xiangwen, and 耶律朮者 is Yelü Shuzhe, as consistently translated in his Liao History biography. The revision also makes the three appointments and their shared campaign explicit.

Imperial sons were enfeoffed: Heluwo as Prince of Yue, Alian as Prince of Xu, Zhongshun Army military commissioner Xiejianu as Prince of Chen, Western Capital regent Tiebu as Prince of Han, tiyin Lüfen as Prince of Liaoxi, mobile palace deployment director Biegu as Prince of Liucheng, and Fengling Army military commissioner Hougu as Prince of Raole; Prince of Anding Nielugu was advanced to Prince of Chu.

Imperial sons were enfeoffed: Heluwo as Prince of Yue, Alian as Prince of Xu, Zhongshun Army military commissioner Xiejianu as Prince of Chen, Western Capital regent Tiebu as Prince of Han, tiyin Lüfen as Prince of Liaoxi, mobile palace deployment director Biegude as Prince of Liucheng, and Fengling Army military commissioner Hougu as Prince of Raole; Prince of Anding Nielugu was advanced to Prince of Chu.
行宮都部署別古得 is three characters 別古得; English Biegu drops 得, and Biegude restores the full name.

Enfeoffed imperial sons: Heluwo as Prince of Yue, Alian as Prince of Xu, Zhongshun Army military commissioner Xiejianu as Prince of Chen, Western Capital regent Tiebu as Prince of Han, tiyin Lüfen as Prince of Liaoxi, mobile palace deployment director Biegu as Prince of Liucheng, and Fengling Army military commissioner Hougu as Prince of Raole; Prince of Anding Nielugu was advanced to Prince of Chu.

Enfeoffed imperial sons: Heluwo as Prince of Yue, Alian as Prince of Xu, Zhongshun Army military commissioner Xiejianu as Prince of Chen, Western Capital regent Tiebu as Prince of Han, tiyin Lüfen as Prince of Liaoxi, mobile palace deployment director Biegude as Prince of Liucheng, and Fengling Army military commissioner Hougu as Prince of Raole; Prince of Anding Nielugu was advanced to Prince of Chu.
Literal likewise truncates 別古得 to Biegu; Biegude matches the Chinese personal name.
On chou day prisoners were reviewed.
On yichou day prisoners were reviewed.
乙丑 is the sexagenary day yichou; “chou day” drops the stem 乙 and misidentifies the day.
Literal likewise omits 乙 from 乙丑; the day name must be yichou.
On the renxu new moon of the sixth month Prince of Han Xiao Hui was made Henan Route campaign supreme commander, with Prince of Zhao Xiao Xiaoyou and Prince of Han Tiebu as deputies.

On the renxu new moon of the sixth month, Xiao Hui, Prince of the Han State, was appointed supreme campaign commander for the Henan Route, with Xiao Xiaoyou, Prince of Zhao, and Tiebu, Prince of Han, as his deputies.
韓國王 and 漢王 are distinct fief titles even though both romanize as Han. 'Prince of the Han State' distinguishes 韓國王 in natural English without inserting Chinese characters or inventing the form Hanguo.
Sixth month, on renxu new moon, made Prince of Han Xiao Hui Henan Route campaign supreme commander, with Prince of Zhao Xiao Xiaoyou and Prince of Han Tiebu as deputies.

Sixth month, on the renxu new moon, appointed Xiao Hui, Prince of the Han State, supreme campaign commander for the Henan Route, with Xiao Xiaoyou, Prince of Zhao, and Tiebu, Prince of Han, as his deputies.
The literal field must likewise distinguish 韓國王 from 漢王. 'Prince of the Han State' preserves that distinction in readable English.
On jisi day, because Liao troops attacked Xia, Song sent Qian Yi with condolence gifts.
On jisi day, because Liao troops attacked Xia, Song sent Qian Yi with parting gifts.
贐禮 are parting/farewell presents for the expedition; “condolence gifts” invents mourning sense absent from 贐 and the campaign context 以遼師伐夏.
On jisi day, because Liao troops attacked Xia, Song dispatched Qian Yi with condolence gifts.
On jisi day, because Liao troops attacked Xia, Song dispatched Qian Yi with parting gifts.
Literal likewise mistranslates 贐禮 as condolence gifts; parting gifts matches the farewell-present sense of 贐.
Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable Xiao Cishinu and Nankge Yelü Wol died in battle.
Xiao Cishinu, chief xiangwen of the Wugu and Dilie tribes, and Yelü Woli, the Southern Ke, died in battle.
都詳穩 is chief xiangwen, 南克 is the military office Southern Ke, and 耶律斡裏 is Yelü Woli. The revision separates both offices from the personal names and restores the final syllable of Woli.
Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable Xiao Cishinu and Nankge Yelü Wol died in battle.
Chief xiangwen of the Wugu and Dilie tribes Xiao Cishinu and Southern Ke Yelü Woli died there.
The literal field must separate the offices 都詳穩 and 南克 from the names Xiao Cishinu and Yelü Woli; 焉 is retained as 'there.'
In the nineteenth year, on gengyin day of the first spring month monk Huijian was promoted acting Grand Master of Inspection.
In the nineteenth year, on gengyin day of the first spring month, the monk Huijian was granted the honorary title of Grand Commandant.
檢校太尉 is an honorary Grand Commandant title, not a Grand Master of Inspection. 加 indicates that the title was added or granted.
In the nineteenth year, spring, first month, on gengyin day, monk Huijian was promoted acting Grand Master of Inspection.
In the nineteenth year, spring, first month, on gengyin day, the monk Huijian was additionally granted the honorary title of Grand Commandant.
The literal field must render 檢校太尉 as the honorary title Grand Commandant and preserve 加 as an additional grant.

On guimao day Southwest pacification commissioner Xiao Punu, Northern Court great king Yixin, linya Xiao Samo, and others were ordered to lead troops against Xia, with mobile palace deployment director Biegu supervising the campaign.

On guimao day Southwest pacification commissioner Xiao Punu, Northern Court great king Yixin, linya Xiao Samo, and others were ordered to lead troops against Xia, with mobile palace deployment director Biegude supervising the campaign.
以行宮都部署別古得監戰 names 別古得; English Biegu drops 得, and Biegude restores the full personal name.

On guimao day, ordered Southwest pacification commissioner Xiao Punu, Northern Court great king Yixin, linya Xiao Samo, and others to lead troops against Xia, with mobile palace deployment director Biegu supervising the campaign.

On guimao day, ordered Southwest pacification commissioner Xiao Punu, Northern Court great king Yixin, linya Xiao Samo, and others to lead troops against Xia, with mobile palace deployment director Biegude supervising the campaign.
Literal likewise truncates 別古得 to Biegu; Biegude matches the Chinese name.
On yiwei day Zubu chief Huedela's younger brother Wodelai came to court, was promoted Grand Master of War, and was sent away.
On yiwei day, Wode, younger brother of the Zubu chief Huodela, came to court. He was granted the title Grand Commandant and sent home.
斡得來朝 is Wode plus the verb 'came to court,' while 豁得剌 is Huodela, as translated in the parallel Liao History chronicle. 太尉 is the granted title Grand Commandant.
On yiwei day, Zubu chief Huedela's younger brother Wodelai came to court and was promoted Grand Master of War before being sent away.
On yiwei day, Wode, younger brother of Zubu chief Huodela, came to court, was granted the title Grand Commandant, and was sent away.
The literal field must separate Wode from 來朝, use the established Huodela spelling, and render 太尉 as Grand Commandant.

On renzi day Southern Court chancellor Han Zhibai was dismissed as Wuding Army military commissioner, associate privy commissioner Yang Ji as Changning Army military commissioner, Hanlin academician Wang Gang as prefect of Ze, Zhang You as prefect of Hui, and drafting edict commissioner Zhou Bai as prefect of Haibei.

On renzi day, Han Zhibai was transferred from the post of Southern Court chancellor to serve as military commissioner of the Wuding Army; associate privy commissioner Yang Ji was appointed military commissioner of the Changning Army; Hanlin academician Wang Gang was appointed prefect of Ze; Zhang You, prefect of Hui; and edict drafter Zhou Bai, prefect of Haibei.
出南府宰相韓知白為武定軍節度使 records a transfer from the central post to the named command, not dismissal. The revision makes the parallel appointments readable.

On renzi day, dismissed Southern Court chancellor Han Zhibai as Wuding Army military commissioner, associate privy commissioner Yang Ji as Changning Army military commissioner, Hanlin academician Wang Gang as prefect of Ze, Zhang You as prefect of Hui, and drafting edict commissioner Zhou Bai as prefect of Haibei.

On renzi day, sent Southern Court chancellor Han Zhibai out to serve as military commissioner of the Wuding Army; associate privy commissioner Yang Ji as military commissioner of the Changning Army; Hanlin academician Wang Gang as prefect of Ze; Zhang You as prefect of Hui; and edict drafter Zhou Bai as prefect of Haibei.
The literal field must preserve 出為 as transfer out to an office while keeping the source's parallel appointment structure.

On dinghai day of the twelfth month Northern Court chancellor and Prince of Zhao Xiao Xiaoyou was dismissed as Eastern Capital regent; Eastern Capital regent Xiao Taliege became Northern Court chancellor; Southern Court privy commissioner and Prince of Lu Chage became Southern Court great king.

On dinghai day of the twelfth month, Xiao Xiaoyou, Northern Court chancellor and Prince of Zhao, was transferred out to serve as regent of the Eastern Capital. Xiao Taliege, regent of the Eastern Capital, became Northern Court chancellor, and Chage, Southern Court privy commissioner and Prince of Lu, became Southern Court great king.
蕭孝友出為東京留守 is a transfer to the Eastern Capital regency, not dismissal. Appositive titles also prevent the names from being fused with their offices.

Twelfth month, on dinghai day, Northern Court chancellor and Prince of Zhao Xiao Xiaoyou was dismissed as Eastern Capital regent; Eastern Capital regent Xiao Taliege became Northern Court chancellor; Southern Court privy commissioner and Prince of Lu Chage became Southern Court great king.

Twelfth month, on dinghai day, Northern Court chancellor and Prince of Zhao Xiao Xiaoyou was sent out to serve as Eastern Capital regent; Eastern Capital regent Xiao Taliege became Northern Court chancellor; Southern Court privy commissioner and Prince of Lu Chage became Southern Court great king.
The literal field must render 出為 as being sent out to serve in the destination office, not being dismissed from it.
On guimao day of the fourth summer month imperial maternal uncle detail-stable Xiao Ala was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner and enfeoffed Prince of Xiping.
On guiwei day of the fourth summer month imperial maternal uncle xiangwen Xiao Ala was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner and enfeoffed Prince of Xiping.
癸未 is guiwei, not guimao (癸卯); 國舅詳穩 is the Khitan office xiangwen, not “detail-stable”.
Summer, fourth month, on guimao day, made imperial maternal uncle detail-stable Xiao Ala Northwest Route pacification commissioner and enfeoffed him Prince of Xiping.
Summer, fourth month, on guiwei day, made imperial maternal uncle xiangwen Xiao Ala Northwest Route pacification commissioner and enfeoffed him Prince of Xiping.
Literal likewise misreads 癸未 as guimao and 詳穩 as detail-stable; guiwei and xiangwen restore both.
Taizu's paternal uncle yilijin Yanmu was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Shu and yuyue Shilu Prince of Sui.
Taizu's paternal uncle yilijin Yanmu was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Shu and yuyue Shilu as Prince of Sui.
於越釋魯為隋國王 is parallel enfeoffment as Prince of Sui; omitting “as” before that title obscures the 為 construction that the proposed wording restores.
On guihai day attendant junior attendant Lu Baofei forged the imperial hand; death was remitted and he was sentenced to corvée for life.
On guihai day, Lu Bao, a junior close attendant, was found to have forged the emperor's handwriting. His death sentence was commuted to lifelong penal servitude.
The person is 盧寶; 偽 belongs to the verb phrase 偽學御書. The revision also removes the duplicated 'attendant junior attendant' and expresses 免死、配役終身 clearly.
On guihai day, attendant junior attendant Lu Baofei forged the imperial hand; death was remitted and he was sentenced to corvée for life.
On guihai day, close-attendant xiaodi Lu Bao falsely imitated the imperial handwriting; he was spared death and assigned to lifelong penal labor.
The literal field separates the name 盧寶 from 偽, preserves the Liao office 小底 as xiaodi, and states both parts of the sentence.
On wuzi day of the eighth month Grand Master of War Wuzhe died; an edict ordered him to share sacrifice in Shengzong's temple.
On wuzi day of the eighth month, Grand Commandant Wuzhe died; an edict ordered that he receive joint sacrifices in Shengzong's temple.
太尉 is Grand Commandant, and 配享 means that Wuzhe was to receive joint sacrifices in Shengzong's ancestral temple.
Eighth month, on wuzi day, Grand Master of War Wuzhe died; edict ordered him to share sacrifice in Shengzong's temple.
Eighth month, on wuzi day, Grand Commandant Wuzhe died; an edict ordered him joined in sacrifice at Shengzong's temple.
The literal field must render 太尉 as Grand Commandant and 配享 as being joined in the temple sacrifices.
On guimao day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
On guiwei day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
癸未 is guiwei, not guimao (癸卯); the idiomatic day stem does not match the Chinese.
On guimao day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
On guiwei day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
Literal likewise misreads 癸未 as guimao; guiwei matches the sexagenary day.
Twelfth month, on bingchen new moon, edict ordered Uighur tribal deputy commissioners to be filled by Khitan persons.
Twelfth month, on bingshen new moon, edict ordered Uighur tribal deputy commissioners to be filled by Khitan persons.
十二月丙申朔 is bingshen, not bingchen (丙辰); the literal new-moon day must be bingshen.

On jiawu day Liaoxing Army military commissioner Xiao Xulie was enfeoffed Prince of Zheng; Southern Court great king and Prince of Lu Chage was made Southern Court privy commissioner and advanced to Prince of Yue.

On jiawu day, Xiao Xulie, military commissioner of the Liaoxing Army, was enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng. Chage, Southern Court great king and Prince of Lu, was appointed Southern Court privy commissioner and promoted to Prince of Yue.
潞王 is Chage's title, not part of his name. Full apposition is clearer and grammatical where a single inserted comma was not.

On jiawu day, Liaoxing Army military commissioner Xiao Xulie was enfeoffed Prince of Zheng; Southern Court great king and Prince of Lu Chage was made Southern Court privy commissioner and advanced to Prince of Yue.

On jiawu day, enfeoffed Liaoxing Army military commissioner Xiao Xulie as Prince of Zheng; made Chage, Southern Court great king and Prince of Lu, Southern Court privy commissioner and promoted him to Prince of Yue.
The literal field separates 查葛 from the title 潞王 with a complete appositive construction.
On guimao day prisoners were reviewed.
On guiwei day prisoners were reviewed.
癸未 is guiwei, not guimao (癸卯); the idiomatic date stem does not match the source.
Literal likewise misreads 癸未 as guimao; guiwei is required.

On jiashen day the ministers presented the Emperor the honorific title Revering Heaven, Upholding the Way, Protecting the Age, Raising the Calendar, Martially Settling, Literaryly Accomplished, Sagely, Spiritually Benevolent, Filial Emperor, and invested Empress Xiao with the title Chaste, Gracious, Kind, Harmonious, Cultured, Favorable, Reverent, Filial, Broadly Loving, Chong, Sagely Empress.

On jiashen day, the ministers conferred on the emperor the honorific title 'Emperor Who Reveres Heaven, Upholds the Way, Aids the Age, Revives the Calendar, Pacifies by Martial Power, Achieves through Culture, and Is Sage, Divine, Benevolent, and Filial.' Empress Xiao was invested as 'Empress Chaste and Gracious, Kind and Harmonious, Cultured and Beneficent, Filial and Reverent, Broadly Loving, and Exalting the Sage.'
The original contains the misspelling 'Literaryly' and splits 崇聖 incorrectly. Rendering the parallel honorific elements as predicates produces readable English while preserving every element.

The literal field corrects the misspelling and keeps 崇聖 together while preserving the title's serial structure.
